manual_demonstration.operator_goal: Verify the official-index disclosure page can produce a strict FY2026 target PDF even when the visible anchor and filename contain 2025.
steps: Use the Saitama official-index URL registered as the school's prefecture_aggregator disclosure site.
Open the information page and inspect the 修学支援 / 申請書 link.
Follow shugakushien_shinsei2025-1-2.pdf despite the 2025 filename hint.
Accept the PDF only after PDF text supplies current target-year evidence for FY2026.

reusable_rules: Use the official-index disclosure page before SERP fallback.
Treat PDF-body target-year evidence as stronger than stale-looking URL or anchor hints.
Keep 2025 in the URL/anchor as an ambiguity signal, but do not reject when the PDF text proves FY2026.
anti_patterns: Do not infer the fiscal year solely from the URL filename.
Do not accept stale-looking PDFs unless body extraction or OCR supplies the configured target fiscal year.
Do not count adjacent school-information or admission PDFs as confirmation forms.

evidence.notes: Windows v150 packaged smoke accepted this PDF with reason=accepted_downloaded and year_evidence=pdf_text for target_fiscal_year=2026.
